scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run local-services" "npm run launch"
scripts.test: npm run build:happ && cargo nextest run -j 1 && npm test -w tests
scripts.launch:classic: hc-spin --ui-port 1420 -n $AGENTS workdir/profiles-test.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:$SIGNAL_PORT
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zome && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zome: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.docs:publish: npm run docs:setup && storybook build && gh-pages -d ./storybook-static -b gh-pages
scripts.docs:setup: npm run build -w @holochain-open-dev/profiles && npm run analyze -w @holochain-open-dev/profiles
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
